answer: Put five jurors on every submission and slash any whose score diverges by two or more from the median. Void the panel and redraw when its members share a host or a funding source. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so a copied answer cannot ride a new ticket. A zephyr of five accounts cannot fill a panel, the void rule catches it first, and the farm's accounts drift to the nadir paying bonds the whole way. Solid as basalt.
